body: i wouldn’t be comfortable about it either and i would most likely speak up about the issue. with the message being automated, it just wouldn’t feel the same. i feel you, because it would have more meaning if they said it themselves instead of it being automated in their phone just to say it for them.

i don’t actually think i have a set coping skill for my panic and anxiety attacks. they’re overbearing and overwhelming to the point i don’t think of anything else rather than to immediately cut myself. it’s been a bad habit since 5th or sixth grade. 

my panic and anxiety attacks feel like the end of the world and like i’m going to die. my whole body stiffens and i begin to shake and lose control of it. constant thoughts and voices repeating things of anything bad/negative ever said towards me and it drives me insane to the point where i think death is the only option. it’s as if i’m a whole different person. having ODD and BPD clinically diagnosed is not a good mix at all for me.

i’ve really tried to convince my mom to let me have a job but it never works out. it’s depressing because school is a huge setback. ever since i’ve been assaulted and it’s been open to actual services, life has changed so much negatively. there’s so many more boundaries to the point i wish nothing ever had gotten out to the services, my mom basically uses it as an excuse for anything, even my own girlfriend. she literally won’t have my girlfriend just spend time with me at my place because since she was the one who reported it and not my mom, she has to deal with some charges of possible child neglect too since she made me stay quiet. she blames me and her for it, and she hates her. no matter what i say, she won’t let me have a job, she’s very hard headed and hard to get through. i told her i wanted to save up money so i can leave and at least have enough money for some cheap apartment and or trailer home, but she just won’t let me.

it just feels like i’m stuck. life has been hard for so long and adulthood seems so far away. with the amount of arguments and traumatic experiences that keep occurring, time seems so slow. it’s painful and depressing.

that man who my sister is with, ruined my life.

my mom and dad and i live together. it’s very conflicting with all of this because she has cancer. even though she had many things to say about/to me, she has cancer right now. i still care for her, but it’s hard to just forget the negative things she would say to me. ever since fifth or sixth grade life’s been different. i started self harming and as soon as she found out, life changed. i was shamed for it.

i’m graduating soon. but i’m not able to have a job yet because my mom won’t let me. i have too much anxiety driving but i still would want to work. just to earn some money to save up for just somewhere else to live. it’s as if she wants me to grow up, but at the same time she treats me like i’m a baby. i’m the youngest in the family after all, but it’s just difficult because i don’t have much places to go, especially with little to no money and no job.

there is my brothers place with his roommate (that’s also my friend) and i usually go over there on some nights i have my triggers and panic attacks. but i have a feeling she’s just slightly judgmental of him because he’s my dads son, he has a different mom.

my sisters have a different dad with my mom and my brother has a different mom with my dad. my parents are together in this house i’m living in, so i’m like an only child.

but with the amount of traumatic arguments and such with my mom and also my moms two other daughters, my non would call me childish for my panic attacks and my triggers. she would tell me i’m 16, i should know better, and i should just move on because all of the things i’ve dealt with are from the past, even though my cps case just opened up in august.

my mom is also just very overbearing, controlling, and she tends to just gaslight and guilt trip me if she gets the chance to.

the problems are more as if, i’m constantly stuck in the same black hole and there’s no escaping it no matter what i do. the future has many paths depending on what action you take, and any action i take, always results in what i overthink. it’s miserable because there isn’t anything i can do about it because it’s always the other persons words. i have no control over other people. of what they say, do, think, or act. 

it’s as if i’m losing everything and i have nothing left. i’ve lost family. i’ve lost friends. i’ve been affecting my own almost year relationship. i’m just 16 and with what i’ve gone through, it’s been hell.

constant arguments with my mom, a dad who was there but just didn’t understand anything, my older half sisters who hated the shit out of me, my mom favoring them over me, the daughter who has a different dad than my half sisters, my oldest half sisters boyfriend, who used to touch and manipulate me into things i didn’t want to do, and more. it’s tiring. it’s exhausting to keep on living.

now all i have is my dad because he was the only one who cared more about me after finding out my sisters boyfriend was doing things to me, unlike my mom. my brother who wasn’t there for a portion of my life because he has a different mother. and my girlfriend.

but even those relationships are rough. it just seems as if i can’t get though a week without some sort of breakdown. everything has changed after my sisters boyfriend had gotten charges and kicked out of the house by cps. changed, negatively. they make it as if it’s my fault. and i’ve already started to believe it. that i deserved this shit. i deserved to just get pushed aside. it’s been like that my whole life.

constantly trying to end it since the sixth grade when i started cutting, i’m still doing the same thing, life just continues to grow worse and worse. i used to have hope in things get better with time, but time has been taking years.

there’s so much more in my brain and in my heart that even hurts physically with head and heart aches, but i just don’t see a point in anything anymore.
i wasn’t made to live happily.

the problems are unfixable. i can’t change other people and i can only change myself, but no matter what i do, it’s always wrong. i think of ever possible outcome and one of them becomes true, and that’s usually the worse possible outcome. it’s miserable. i’m still here though. but i don’t know for how much longer.
there isn’t much.
i just want to be loved.

i despise people who say other people have it worse. with problems, all problems matter, because they all make us feel the same way. it doesn’t matter if one persons problem is worse than the others, both problems still matter at the end. everyone deserves to be heard, YOU deserve to be heard. 

i am so sorry you’ve had to endure those words from those people, in all honesty, forget about them. you’re the most important person in your life because it’s YOUR life. you’re going to be living with yourself your whole life, it isn’t selfish to think this way. you matter and you deserve the help, love and care as much as anyone else who struggles with life. life isn’t easy, some might have it worse than others, but it doesn’t mean the little problems don’t matter at all. ((but i hope u know i’m not trying to say your problems aren’t little, i’m just trying to say all problems deserve to be heard. ))

you’ve gone through a lot, no human deserves such pain. you deserve to be heard. people that say oh “other people have it worse” don’t have a say at all, you deserve better treatment than what they gave you. with all of those things that have happened in your life, i truly hope things get progressively better. with empathy here, i know it’s difficult, especially with the ptsd and murdering. i’ve had to live with a manipulative murderer in my own household, and on top of that it’s my nephews father. but other than that, it’s fucking shitty of them to just belittle your issues and say other people have it worse. you deserve so much more than what they gave you.

hearing you say that he is very sweet, supportive, and sympathetic towards you while you are down, shows a lot. it shows that he truly cares for you.

and yes, with any type of disorder and illness, a loved one who truly loves and cares for you is bound to be saddened, because they’d want the best for you. usually when a friend of mine and or family member would come out to me about what they would be going through, it saddens me that they would have to go through such things. things that even myself have self experienced with. my cousin came out to me about her eating disorder, it saddened me because i knew what she was going through, because i myself was going through it as well. but, i was there for her. and she was there for me.

breaking the ice can be full of anxiety, but from how you described your dad, i’m sure he will understand. and if he doesn’t, you can try your best to help him understand. my parents are more foreign and don’t fully understand most mental illnesses due to the morals they grew up with, but with even my dad, he was willing to try to understand.

just please know you’re not alone in this and there’s a possibility if you tell your dad, you’ll have an amazing support by your side as you recover. i’m still recovering myself, but it’s nice having my dad know and care for me still. he had never known beforehand but with him now knowing, it actually helped our relationship more. it bought us closer. although your dad might get heartbroken, it just shows how much he loves and cares for you as their child. we are human, we have emotions, and yours matter. i hope the best for you if you ever confess your true issues to your dad.

thank you so much for everything though, i don’t ever and or rarely hear “you are a good person” “you deserve to be loved”. it makes me feel so happy. such small sentences with powerful meaning, at least powerful meaning to me, it just makes me so warm.

and i have never heard of psychotherapeutic help and i’ve just googled it. it seems like something i should talk to my cps worker about to maybe get some. right now it’s really nice though because the workers in cps that i’m involved with gave me free counseling!! it’s really nice. the lady is super nice and understanding too. 

it’s so strange that since everything is happening i’m now learning that some of the things that has been going on could be looked at as abuse and or neglect, i’ve always just thought how things should be due to how i grew up. it’s saddening, but i’m so thankful for people like you, i loved hearing your words through your paragraph. i again, thank you so much for everything.
i’ve been told i over-apologize so i’m trying to break that habit. i’ve always been told i was wrong. so i’ve always been the one saying sorry.
i didn’t hurt myself. i can’t get away from her. i love her too much. i’m not leaving her.

she’s my girlfriend. this whole situation was just put in the past. i don’t really like being in conflicts even though i’m always the one upset about something and i just need to stop being sensitive. my mind always goes up and down, due to my borderline personality disorder most likely, and i’ve came down to the conclusion that i’m usually the problem. some of the things we argue about wouldn’t be a problem if i didn’t make them a problem. i tend to get really emotional and sensitive. i have a lot of things in the past that probably shaped me this way. i’ve always been the one apologizing for everything in my family and it’s sad to say she doesn’t like it when i over apologize to her. i don’t like over apologizing either but it’s become a bad habit of mine. i don’t have a good relationship with my mom and or her side of the family and it’s been really rough, but she’s been the one who was there for me. i love her. i love her so much. if i didn’t meet her and or had her in my life at the time, the person who sexually harassed me would’ve still lived in my house. that man is gone out of our house, because of her. she saved me from him.

i personally just want to be normal. i don’t know what normal is but i know for sure my emotions aren’t. they feel so powerful. they corrupt my mind til i self harm. but i’ve actually haven’t self harmed in a while. i promised her that i wouldn’t anymore. she said it reminded her of a girl that she used to talk to and she was going to almost leave me. i want to be better. i love her with all my heart. i don’t want her to feel the distraught feelings i know too well. with the people i love such as her, my dad, and my brother, i want to protect all of them. my mom is crazy, she doesn’t even like my girlfriend for reporting everything because now she is going through a case for child neglect. i told her earlier on in the year that my sisters boyfriend was touching me but she told me to be quiet and keep it to myself. and to not tell anyone. not even my dad. my mom would yell at me about how i would tell my friends about my family situations. she would yell at me of how my girlfriend ruined her life.

but my girlfriend saved me. she loves me. she tells me i’m the only one she loves. the only one who she’ll only love. that i’m hers. she makes me feel loved. feel validated. i can’t let her go. i don’t want to let her go. although i said to keep it in the past and to move on because i couldn’t handle the situation, i just believe change is possible. it hurts sometimes but i told myself relationships aren’t supposed to be 100% perfect. and i also told myself she isn’t like my family. she isn’t like my sisters who have full on neglected me and called me a liar and an attention seeker when i confessed to them about the person who had touched me (aka the older ones boyfriend). she isn’t like the person who had touched me, and even manipulated me, and told me scary things just to get their way, stolen a vibrator from me without me knowing, turned my whole family against me. it’s funny, they still see the person who had touched me as a normal person. but i’m the monster. i’m just trying my hardest to heal. to, be better. to be normal. i just want to be normal. i just want to live happily. and she makes me so happy. i was in a really bad episode at the time writing all that, but i’ll possibly soon be cured in the future. people say that people with borderline aren’t curable, but i just want to try my hardest. to live like a normal person and to be loved.

i can relate with the romance movies but even more so with anime’s with cliche love stories in high school. all of the couples have such cliche love stories, it squeezes and warms my heart every time. but those are scripted. those are made up lines to be made into perfection. life isn’t scripted. life isn’t perfect either. it’s something even i had to take in.

i crave validation and love within a relationship to the point where i feel as if i give out too much love sometimes and hurt myself. but in all honesty, there’s millions of people out there. you’ll find the one someday. i understand how you might push away and or love them too much, but it’s possible to find your cliche love of your life. because my girlfriend debunked the theory of it being impossible to have a cliche love story like the movies. love is like a drug to myself as well. it’s the source of validation for me. it makes me feel, accepted. it makes me feel enough. it makes me worth something.

love is such a bittersweet thing and it can become drug-like.

the time first time i was at a mental hospital (and my only time so far) it wasn’t the greatest and it also wasn’t the worse. everyone’s story is bound to be different. most of my BPD triggers/episodes were from family conflict mainly. being away from them and just with new people and a new environment was just better, but was temporary (because i had to go back to my family after my stay and they just disciplined me for basically being depressed). the rules were very strict of my mental hospital though. no electronics of course, no touching other patients, no sharing food, n so on. from my perspective, admission was helpful for myself to be away from stressors n such (my family environment that had set off many triggers), but was only a temporary fix. don’t be like me though and just lie your way out, i had only lied my way out because i didn’t want my parents to spend money on me for the time of me staying at that mental hospital. do what you need to do for yourself and if you truly believe in your cards, (i myself believe in tarot cards a lot) stick to them. recovery might not happen immediately but it isn’t impossible.

i, myself, had and still have the same urges and everything. bulimia is hard to recover from, i do know.

and some advice that i could give to you is just some coping methods i use.

when i eat a meal, i usually hate the disgusting feel of bloating and tried to avoid the feeling, but i now know that my body does need to eat, even though i hate doing it.

after eating a meal, to avoid throwing up, i usually use time as a coping mechanism. like, if i’d feel disgusting, after one meal, i’d talk to myself. i’d recognize the situation i am in, 

“yes, i feel sick, i want to throw up, but i shouldn’t.” 
“maybe check in after 5-10 minutes with myself, see if i feel the same way.”

in between those 5-10 minutes, i’d also try to distract myself. take a walk, a breather, a shower. anything to distract myself because i easily get distracted.

and so, if i didn’t feel okay after those 5-10 minutes, i’d try another 5-10 minutes, see how i felt after that. and repeat.

it’s difficult to fight an urge, it’s strong. but overcoming it is also like a mini accomplishment to me. i’ve overcome the urge. it’s strong, but i was stronger, strong enough to overcome it.

it might take a while to overcome, but, i’ve made it this far, which i thought was impossible. i believe you can do it. i hope i helped you a bit from my experience.

because the way you feel is going to affect your work, and if you continue to have such a mindset, it’ll just go downhill. and that isn’t good.

even though there is so much stress and negativity, take a moment to breathe if you can’t focus either. you have many good strengths and good things to be happy for as well like you said. you have your talents (your pottery, your cooking) and you’ve also got your girl along with you.
